verdict.rationale: Epic's Blueprints Visual Scripting docs say designers can use "virtually the full range of concepts and tools generally only available to programmers," and the Remote Control reference confirms functions can be "defined and implemented entirely in Blueprint." Community users confirm Blueprints are a real, usable no-code workflow, but note it degrades for complex systems, where they recommend C++. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party detail on Blueprint gameplay features (the evidence is a single summary line), and independent corroboration that complex gameplay logic stays viable without C++ (community reports performance cascades at high Blueprint complexity and some tasks requiring C++).
